en.install: Install the detected WorkBuddy plugin from Settings → Agent plugins in ShowAI, or register the prepared directory as a local WorkBuddy marketplace and install ShowAI. Start a new local task and check its connectors and tools.
en.features: Show interactive previews and page cards in chat. When a task provides an embedded browser, use the card’s edit link to open the original.

zh.install: 在 ShowAI 的「设置 → Agent 插件」安装检测到的 WorkBuddy，或将准备好的目录注册为 WorkBuddy 本地插件市场并安装 ShowAI。新建本机任务，检查连接器和工具。
zh.features: 聊天内显示交互预览和原页卡片。任务提供内置浏览器时，用卡片的编辑链接打开原页。
